d: Ten celebrities, including "Blue Peter" presenter Andy Akinwolere, actress Ali Bastian and rugby legend Martin Offiah, take on the might of "Total Wipeout."

A dramatic finale, as the finest contestants from across the series, champions and losing finalists, once again hop on the flight to South America to take on the snow-clad, foam-padded obstacle course.
Twenty crazy contestants throw themselves around a course in the hope of winning £10,000.
John Fashanu, Chantelle Houghton and Calum Best are among celebrities competing for £10,000 for their chosen charity.
Twenty new competitors brave the extreme course  Richard Hammond hosts the event and Amanda Byram covers the action on the sidelines.
The beauties and the geeks compete on separate teams to take each other out.
Ten celebrities take on one of television's most extreme obstacle courses.
